claims.statement: Charley Gallagher had lately beaten Tom Allen, according to a sporting notice reprinted here; the notice is headed 1860 but the items concern 1869.
claims.excerpt: barley Gallagher, who lately beat Tom Allen,

claims.statement: A reprinted 1869 sporting notice says disgraceful scenes were enacted at the fight between Allen and McCoole.
claims.excerpt: etween Allen and McCoole will be tolerated

fights.excerpt: barley Gallagher, who lately beat Tom Allen,
fights.notes: Mentioned in passing in a notice headed June 15, printed 1860 (probably 1869). Date, place and details of the bout are not given.

fights.excerpt: etween Allen and McCoole will be tolerated
fights.notes: Result not given. The notice says disgraceful scenes were enacted at the fight.

notes: Both Allen mentions are in a reprinted 'sport notes from old files' column. The hint that Gallagher was expected in Kansas City is not in the text; the notice lists him among noted members expected at the final King-Hickey deposit.
